solution:
The correct answer is **'__(i) - (c), (ii) - (b), (iii) - (a)__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Red cabbage leaves:

 
• Red cabbage indicator is** a purple-coloured solution** that is used to** test whether substances are acid or base.**
 
• Red cabbage that is often found in homes can be used to prepare **a solution that acts as a natural pH indicator**.
 
• The cabbage basically contains a pigment molecule called **flavin or anthocyanin **that changes **colour depending on the acidity** of the solution.

**Methyl orange:**

 
• Methyl orange is used as **an indicator.** It shows **colour changes in acid, base and neutral substance**.
 
• Methyl orange is** a weak base.**
 
• Methyl orange** indicator is used in the strong acid weak base titration.**
 
• The colour **change of methyl orange depends upon the pH of the solution**.
 
• In acidic medium means** pH below 3.0 it shows red colour.**
 
• In the **range 3.0 - 4.5 pH, Methyl orange is of orange colour** and in **basic medium shows yellow colour.**

**Onion, clove:**

 
• Vanilla, clove and onion are **olfactory indicators.**
 
• An olfactory indicator is **a substance whose smell varies depending on whether it is mixed with an acidic or a basic** solution.
